# EVO's Transit kit is high-roof only, so nothing in the range fits an L3H2

*standard · 3 angles · 3 sources (0 opened, 0 via Bright Data) · 1 disconfirming search*

**Question:** Which of this supplier's configurations suit our van
**Scope:** One supplier, one base vehicle.

---

## Answer

Every Transit product the supplier lists is specified for the high roof [1], and
the wet room cubicle is too tall for a medium roof by a margin no build-up
recovers [2].

---

## Findings

### Finding 1: The whole Transit range is high-roof

**Confidence: Moderate** - the supplier's own category listing, plus an
independent round-up reached from a different angle.

Every panel in the Transit category carries the high-roof designation [1], and a
supplier round-up says the same of the segment [3].

### Finding 2: The cubicle does not fit a medium roof

**Confidence: Weak** - one supplier page, no independent confirmation.

The cubicle is listed at 2088mm tall [2], against roughly 1886mm of bare
interior height in the medium-roof van [3].

---

## Limitations

Every source here was read as a search result rather than opened.

---
